bits_per_sample.docs:
**positive integer**: The bit depth of the audio stream. Must be between `8` and `32`. Every output speaker must use this bit depth.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The router speaker to control. Defaults to the only one in your YAML.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#routerspeakerswitch_output-action)*

num_channels.docs:
**positive integer**: The number of audio channels. Either `1` or `2`. Every output speaker must use this number of channels.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#configuration-variables)*

output_speakers.docs:
**list of [IDs](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: A list of [speakers](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) the router can output to. Must have at least 2 and at most 8 speakers. The first speaker listed is the active output when the device boots.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#configuration-variables)*

sample_rate.docs:
**positive integer**: The sample rate of the audio stream in Hz. Must be between `8000` and `96000`. Every output speaker must use this sample rate.

*See also: [Router Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/router#configuration-variables)*
